newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator drops 14 cents to 706c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator drops 14 cents to 706c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell another 14 cents to 706 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, making a total drop of 47 cents this week, Wool International said.

Merino fleece fell again, with 19 microns down 1.5 percent, 20m down four percent, 21m down three percent, 22m down 2.5 percent, 23m down 0.5 percent and 24/25/26m down one percent, while merino skirtings were down one percent.
In crossbreds, 27m was one percent cheaper, 28/29m up to one percent dearer, and 30/31m slightly cheaper.
In cardings, lambs and locks were generally unchanged with crutchings unchanged.
WI said Japanese interests, Western Europe and China were principal buyers with support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 22,404 bales offered, 17 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 136,490 bales to be offered.
